GeneralResetSpr.name: Spawn shelless Koopa from shell
summary: Turns the Koopa in X into a shelless (beheaded) Koopa: takes a free sprite slot, makes it a walking shelless Koopa of the matching colour at the
same position, and hops it away from Mario. If the old [$1540] timer was 1 it instead gets a fast X speed and a short
no-contact delay, and a Yellow Koopa also spawns a moving coin (SpawnMovingCoin).
Parameters: X: sprite index of the Koopa. Returns: nothing; returns early if no sprite slot is free.

SpawnMovingCoin.name: Spawn moving coin from Koopa
summary: Spawns a Moving Coin (sprite $21) at the position of the sprite in X, tossed upward ($D0) in direction [$01].
Parameters: X: spawning sprite, Y: free sprite slot, [$01]: direction for the coin.

s0197AD.name: Table: X speed for shelless Koopa popped out
summary: Indexed by SubHorizPos result: $C0 (-$40) if Mario is on the right, $40 if on the left. Used by GeneralResetSpr.

s0197D5.name: Bounce sprite off the ground
summary: Called when a dropped or thrown sprite lands: halves its X speed (sign preserved) and sets its Y speed from a bounce table
indexed by the old Y speed / 4 (Goombas add $13 to the index and bounce higher). Keeps the speed if [$1588] bit 7 is set.
Followed (starting at $019806) by the stunned/default sprite drawing routine: body via SubSprGfx2Entry1, plus wake-up feet.
The feet are two 8x8 tiles drawn in the first OAM slots, only for frame 6 and only while the stun timer is running out; the body shakes by 1 pixel.

s0198A7.name: Table: disco shell wall bounce X speed
summary: Indexed by [$1588] & 3: right wall -> $E0, left wall -> $20 (read from $0198A6+Y).

s0198A9.name: Disco shell: kicked behaviour
summary: Kicked-state routine for sprites with [$187B] set (the disco shell). It homes in on Mario: faces him every 32 frames, accelerates
by 2 per frame up to +-$20, bounces off walls and cycles its palette every other frame. Sprites locked: draws only.
Ends by jumping into the shared interaction/offscreen code of HandleSprKicked ($01998C).

s019910.name: Unused data
summary: Three bytes $F0,$EE,$EC, not referenced from this chunk (probably unused).

HandleSprKicked.name: Sprite status: kicked (shell)
summary: Main routine for sprite status $0A. Disco shells divert to $0198A9. Handles slowing down (turns into a stunned shell when the X speed
drops below $20 and [$1528] is clear), gravity/slope handling, wall bounces, and sprite/Mario interaction.
Throw blocks continue at StunThrowBlock; everything else is drawn by $019A2A.
Sub-entry $01999E: wall hit reaction (sound, flip direction, hit the block if on screen, break Throw Blocks).

BreakThrowBlock.name: Break Throw Block sprite
summary: Frees the sprite slot and, if on screen, shatters a brick at the sprite's position using ShatterBlock (bank 2).
Parameters: X: sprite index of the Throw Block.

SetSomeYSpeed??.name: Set Y speed when on ground
summary: Sets the sprite's Y speed to 0, or to $18 if it is on a slope ([$15B8] non-zero) or [$1588] bit 7 is set. Keeps the sprite glued to slopes.
Parameters: X: sprite index.

UpdateDirection.name: Set direction from X speed
summary: [RAM_SpriteDir] = 0 if X speed > 0, 1 if X speed < 0; unchanged if the speed is 0.
Parameters: X: sprite index.

ShellAniTiles.name: Table: shell animation frames
summary: Spinning shell frames ($1602 values): $06,$07,$08,$07.

ShellGfxProp.name: Table and draw: spinning shell
summary: Table: X-flip bit XORed into the shell's OAM property per animation frame ($00,$00,$00,$40).
$019A2A: draws a kicked shell. Temporarily copies [$C2] into [$1558], picks the frame from [$14] / 4, draws it and flips it as per the table.

SpinJumpSmokeTiles.name: Table: spin jump smoke tiles
summary: Smoke puff tiles used while a spin-jumped sprite fades: $64,$62,$60,$62.

HandleSprSpinJump.name: Sprite status: spin jump killed
summary: Main routine for sprite status 4: draws the sprite with a puff of smoke tile chosen by the timer [$1540] (/8 mod 4),
and erases it when the timer is 0.

SpinJumpEraseSpr.name: Erase sprite and status 5 handler
summary: $019A77: permanently erases the sprite (OffScrEraseSprite). $019A7B: main routine for status 5 (sinking in lava):
erases when [$1558] is 0, otherwise Y speed = 4, X speed decays by 1 toward 0 (stops at a wall) and sprite goes behind layers,
then falls through into HandleSprKilled.

HandleSprKilled.name: Sprite status: killed
summary: Main routine for sprite status 2 (falling off screen). Special cases: Wiggler calls its main routine, Lakitu sets [$18E0] = $FF,
Throw Blocks break, Exploding Block Enemy explodes. Sprites whose tweaker [$1656] bit 7 is set turn into status 4 (smoke puff, timer $1F).
Others move (unless locked), run SubOffscreen and are drawn by HandleSpriteDeath.

HandleSprSmushed.name: Sprite status: smushed
summary: Main routine for sprite status 3. Frees the slot when [$1540] reaches 0; otherwise falls into ShowSmushedGfx.

ShowSmushedGfx.name: Move and draw smushed sprite
summary: Moves the sprite, zeroes X speed on the ground and draws it: Dino Torch uses the standard 16x16 routine with tile $AC,
everything else uses SmushedGfxRt ($01E700). Entry $019AFE draws without moving.

HandleSpriteDeath.name: Draw killed sprite
summary: Draws a sprite that died (status 2/5): if tweaker [$167A] bit 0 is set the main routine draws it. Otherwise, 2-tile-high death
frames go through SubSprGfx1 (flipped upside down unless Lakitu), the rest through SubSprGfx2Entry0 with a vertical flip (A = $80, or $00 if Y = $1C; Y is not set here).
Sprites behind scenery temporarily set layer priority [$64] = $10 while drawing.

SprTilemap.name: Table: generic sprite tile numbers
summary: Tile numbers for the generic sprite graphics routines, indexed by SprTilemapOffset[sprite number] + animation frame ([$1602]).
For 4-tile sprites the index steps by 4 per frame; for 2-tile sprites by 2.

SprTilemapOffset.name: Table: tile table offset per sprite
summary: Index into SprTilemap for each sprite number $00-$53 (84 entries).

GeneralSprDispX.name: Table: 4-tile X offsets
summary: X offsets of the 4 tiles in a 2x2 sprite: $00,$08,$00,$08.

GeneralSprDispY.name: Table: 4-tile Y offsets
summary: Y offsets of the 4 tiles in a 2x2 sprite: $00,$00,$08,$08.

GeneralSprGfxProp.name: Table: 4-tile OAM properties
summary: OAM flip bits for each tile of a 2x2 sprite, 4 bytes per row, row chosen by [$05] (0-5): $40 = X flip, $80 = Y flip.

SubSprGfx0Entry0.name: Draw 2x2 sprite (default Y offset)
summary: Entry with Y offset 0 into SubSprGfx0Entry1. Parameters: A: property row (0-5).

SubSprGfx0Entry1.name: Draw sprite from four 8x8 tiles
summary: Draws a 2x2 sprite of four 8x8 tiles in the sprite's OAM slots. Tile numbers from SprTilemap, flips from GeneralSprGfxProp.
Parameters: A: property row (0-5), Y: Y offset added to the drawing Y position.

GenericSprGfxRt1.name: Long call to SubSprGfx1
summary: Sets the data bank to $01 and calls SubSprGfx1 (RTL, for use from other banks).

SubSprGfx1.name: Draw sprite from two stacked tiles
summary: Draws a 16x32 sprite (two 16x16 tiles stacked) using SubSprGfx1Hlpr0, or the upside-down variant if [RAM_SpritePal] bit 7 is set.

SubSprGfx1Hlpr0.name: Draw two stacked tiles, upright
summary: Writes top and bottom 16x16 tiles from SprTilemap ([$1602] * 2 + offset), Y offset $10 apart, X flip depending on direction.
Sprites numbered below $0F use OAM slots one further in (Y + 4). Marks the tiles 16x16 and handles off-screen via CODE_01A3DF.
